verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents person tracking that records which users are affected by each error. This works automatically in Rails and Django and needs configuration elsewhere, which covers the 'how many users' half of the story. Sessions appear only as a session-replay feature and a pricing quota, not as a per-issue count of affected sessions, and nothing shows sorting or prioritizing items by blast radius. Missing for 10: per-issue affected-session counts, evidence of ranking or filtering issues by affected users/sessions instead of occurrence counts, independent corroboration.
